title: O-030 is recorded as DISCHARGED, but no test has ever fed its shape.
how_to_read: Each attempt is one line and a `details` filename in this same directory. Open a detail file ONLY when this index points you at one -- the summaries are here so you do not have to. `caused_by` is what sent the stage back; `changed` is what the attempt then touched, counted by kind. Several attempts in a row that were caused by the same stage and changed no `src` is a loop, not progress.

open.issue: observed: Exception at line 52: "O-030 is recorded as done=True in ...\.taad\slices\SL-038\build-slice-2.json, but its own evidence says the test 'has NEVER run on the extracted rig, by me or anyone' and 'remains owed to the person'."
Ledger obligation O-030 in .taad/slices/SL-038/build-slice-2.json is recorded as owed to the person (done: false), not discharged: missing
StalledShareTests (the C1 baseline) has actually run on the extracted rig (Rig/SmbRig.cs) since extraction, independent of what the ledger claims: missing
A prior build attempt for SL-062 has already performed the ledger correction: missing
The SMB-LOOPBACK command itself: it is person-run by contract and changes the machine's SMB mappings. Build did not run it and does not claim it.
Showing O-030 in the engine's own obligation queue (M1): that store is not in this worktree. I recorded this as an engine-side gap and did not claim routing.
The rig's mechanical person-sitting guard (M5): it is code, so it is out of scope for a ledger-only slice and is filed under follow_ups.

Engine-side obligation (M1): SL-038's obligation state lives in the engine's store (build-slice-2.json is export run_id 1047), and that store still holds O-030 done:true. The hand-edit here does not change the store. A re-export of SL-038 would put done:true back, and it would also turn the repro and C-003 red. The engine needs a way to reopen an obligation on a merged slice through its disposition, and a queue of person-owed items that a slice can read from the tree.

Mechanical guard (M5), code, not built here: the rig should refuse New-SmbMapping unless a person-sitting marker is set, for example an environment variable that only the person sets. Today 'no engine stage runs Network=SMB-LOOPBACK' is kept only by stages remembering it, and spike#55 on this slice did not.

The person's network check is owed: `WindowCases.ps1 -Case All -IncludeNetwork`, then `eng/dotnet.ps1 test tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests.csproj --filter Network=SMB-LOOPBACK` (~70 s). Record the HEAD, pass or fail for N-001..N-004 and StalledShareTests (O-030), and N-001's Cancel-to-return in SL-020-scanner.md. On 2026-09-27 a read-only Get-SmbMapping showed 0 leftover \\127.0.0.1\ mappings.
